## 说明

本函数对`cmsy_input()`准备好的种群运行本包附带的CMSY++代码（CMSY++16.R，2021年1月版，见`cmsy_sources()`），并汇总结果：最大可持续产量（MSY）、Bmsy和Fmsy，每年的相对资源量（B/Bmsy）和相对捕捞死亡率（F/Fmsy）及其95%置信限，最后一年各Kobe象限的概率，以及每个种群的状态。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function runs the CMSY++ code bundled with the package (`CMSY++16.R`, January 2021, see
`cmsy_sources()`) on the stocks prepared by `cmsy_input()`, and collects the results: MSY,
Bmsy and Fmsy, relative stock size (B/Bmsy) and exploitation (F/Fmsy) in every year with
their 95% confidence limits, the probability of each Kobe quadrant in the last year, and the
status of each stock.

</details>

## 用法

```r
cmsy_run(
  input,
  stocks = NULL,
  out_dir = "cmsy",
  parallel = NULL,
  plots = c("analysis", "management", "kobe"),
  os = "auto",
  device = c("file", "screen"),
  seed = NULL,
  auto_start = FALSE,
  settings = list(),
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  silent = fao_setting("silent"),
  timeout = 3600
)
```

## 参数

`input`
:   `cmsy_input()`的结果。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The result of `cmsy_input()`.

    </details>

`stocks`
:   要运行的种群（可选）：`Stock`标识（例如"PIL_34"），或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码（运行该物种的所有种群）。默认为NULL，即`input`中的所有种群。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Optional stocks to run: `Stock` identifiers (e.g. "PIL_34") or species, by
    English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code (all stocks of the
    species). Default is NULL, all stocks of `input`.

    </details>

`out_dir`
:   CMSY++输出的文件夹。默认为工作目录下的"cmsy"。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The folder for the CMSY++ output. Default is "cmsy" in the working directory.

    </details>

`parallel`
:   同时运行的种群数。每个种群还要为其两条MCMC链另外使用两个进程。默认为处理器核心数的一半。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The number of stocks run at the same time. Each uses two more processes for
    its two MCMC chains. Default is half the number of processor cores.

    </details>

`plots`
:   要保存为JPEG文件的CMSY++图表："analysis"、"management"、"kobe"、"prior_posterior"和"retrospective"中的任意几项。默认为前三项。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The CMSY++ charts to save as JPEG files: any of "analysis", "management", "kobe",
    "prior_posterior" and "retrospective". Default is the first three.

    </details>

`os`
:   采用哪个操作系统的设置："auto"（默认，自动检测）、"windows"、"macos"或"linux"。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The operating system whose settings are used: "auto" (default, detect it),
    "windows", "macos" or "linux".

    </details>

`device`
:   CMSY++在将图表保存为JPEG文件之前绘图所用的设备："file"（默认），一种屏幕外图形设备，在所有系统上和批处理运行中都可用；或"screen"，即系统自身的图形窗口（`windows()`、`quartz()`或`x11()`）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Where CMSY++ draws its charts before saving them as JPEG files: "file"
    (default), an off-screen device that works on every system and in batch runs, or
    "screen", the system's own window (`windows()`, `quartz()` or `x11()`).

    </details>

`seed`
:   随机数种子（可选），使运行可以重复并得到相同的结果。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Optional random seed, so runs can be repeated with the same results.

    </details>

`auto_start`
:   逻辑值。当前三年的平均（平滑）渔获量低于最大值的三分之一、起始年份早于2000年且没有给出起始B/k先验时，CMSY++会警告起始生物量不明确（已衰减还是尚未开发），并建议从渔获量至少达到最大值40%的第一年开始（报告在`suggested_start_year`中）。为TRUE时，种群从该年开始。CMSY++自身的相应设置（`auto.start`）在CMSY++16.R中会报错停止（年份范围不再与渔获量年份一致），因此本函数在运行前将同样的规则应用于`StartYear`。默认为FALSE，与CMSY++相同；用户指南更推荐在`cmsy_input()`中设定`StartYear`或起始B/k先验（`stb.low`、`stb.hi`）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. When the mean (smoothed) catch of the first three years is
    below a third of the maximum, the start year is before 2000 and no start B/k prior is
    given, CMSY++ warns that the start biomass is ambiguous (depleted or unexploited) and
    suggests starting in the first year with at least 40% of the maximum catch (reported
    in `suggested_start_year`). If TRUE, the stock starts in that year. CMSY++'s own
    setting for this (`auto.start`) stops with an error in `CMSY++16.R` (the year range no
    longer matches the catch years), so the same rule is applied here to `StartYear`
    before the run. Default is FALSE, as in CMSY++; the user guide prefers setting
    `StartYear` or the start B/k prior (`stb.low`, `stb.hi`) in `cmsy_input()`.

    </details>

`settings`
:   可选的命名列表，给出用于替代CMSY++默认值的设置，例如`list(CV.C = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000)`。各项设置、其默认值和作用见`cmsy_defaults()`。默认为不作更改：CMSY++使用其自身的默认值运行。所用的设置保存在运行文件夹的`settings_used.csv`和`result$settings`中。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Optional named list of CMSY++ settings that replace its defaults, e.g.
    `list(CV.C = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000)`. See `cmsy_defaults()` for the
    settings, their defaults and what they do. Default is no change: CMSY++ runs with its own
    defaults. The settings used are saved in `settings_used.csv` of the run folder and in
    `result$settings`.

    </details>

`table`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in `tables/`.

    </details>

`lang`
:   图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
    "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
    `fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).

    </details>

`silent`
:   逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，用进度条显示已完成的种群数以及已用时间和预计剩余时间，并输出运行信息；为TRUE时不输出任何内容。可以用`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`更改本次R会话的默认值。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If FALSE (default), a progress bar shows how many stocks have
    finished, with the elapsed and the estimated remaining time, and messages report the
    run. If TRUE, nothing is printed. The default can be changed for the session with
    `fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`.

    </details>

`timeout`
:   单个种群的最长运行时间（秒）；超过后仍在运行的种群会被终止，并记为"timeout"（如果其主分析已经完成，则记为"partial"）。默认值为3600。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Maximum time for one stock, in seconds; a stock still running after it is
    stopped and reported as "timeout" (or "partial" if its main analysis had finished).
    Default is 3600.

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个`cmsy_result`类的列表，包含`summary`（每个种群一行：生物学参考点、最后一年的状态及其95%置信限、Kobe象限概率、所用的先验及其来源链接）、`series`（逐年：渔获量、预测渔获量、B/k、生物量、B/Bmsy、F和F/Fmsy，以及95%置信限）、`kobe`（最后一年的后验抽样值）、`details`（每个种群：r、k和B/k的后验抽样值、先验、回顾性分析的各次运行）、`logs`、`sources`（CMSY++、JAGS、R和数据的版本）和`changes`（对CMSY++代码所做的修改）。汇总表保存在tables/cmsy/。其中的`run_status`在该种群运行无错误结束时为"ok"；主分析已保存结果、但之后的步骤（回顾性分析或某张图）失败或超时时为"partial"；没有结果时为"failed"或"timeout"；`exit`记录运行是怎样结束的。其他函数使用"ok"和"partial"种群的结果。运行完成并不等于评估经过核实：神经网络给出的B/k先验"may not be appropriate for your stock"（可能不适合你的种群，CMSY++用户手册），因此应逐个种群核对（自行设定先验见`cmsy_input()`）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a list of class `cmsy_result` with `summary` (one row per stock: reference
points, last-year status with 95% limits, Kobe probabilities, the priors used and the
links to their sources), `series` (by year: catch, predicted catch, B/k, biomass,
B/Bmsy, F and F/Fmsy, with 95% limits), `kobe` (the last-year draws), `details`
(per stock: posterior draws of r, k and B/k, the priors, retrospective runs), `logs`,
`sources` (the versions of CMSY++, JAGS, R and the data) and `changes` (the changes
made to the CMSY++ code). The summary is saved in `tables/cmsy/`. Its `run_status` is
"ok" when the run of the stock finished without error, "partial" when the main analysis
saved its results but a later step (the retrospective analysis or a chart) failed or ran
out of time, and "failed" or "timeout" when there are no results; `exit` says how the
run ended. The other functions use the results of "ok" and "partial" stocks. A
finished run is not a validated assessment: the B/k priors suggested by the neural
network "may not be appropriate for your stock" (CMSY++ user guide), so check them
stock by stock (see `cmsy_input()` for setting your own).

</details>

## 详细说明

每个种群在`out_dir`下各自的文件夹中、在单独的R进程中运行，使用一份针对本机修改过的代码副本（见`cmsy_system()`：按照用户指南为macOS和Linux修改`windows()`和`antialias`，并去掉依赖RStudio的代码、已从CRAN存档的snpar包和自动安装包的代码）。这些文件夹保留CMSY++的原始输出（`cmsy_output.csv`、JPEG图表和日志），便于逐一核查每个结果。

FAO数据没有资源丰度指数，因此只运行CMSY++中仅基于渔获量的部分。FAO（2026）的全球评估将CMSY++列为第3级（Tier 3，数据有限）方法之一；按照其做法，状态只分为两类：最大可持续捕捞（"maximally sustainably fished"，最后一年B/Bmsy至少为0.8）或过度捕捞（"overfished"，B/Bmsy低于0.8）；仅基于渔获量的结果不用于将种群判定为低度捕捞。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Each stock runs in its own folder under `out_dir` and in a separate R process, with a copy of
the code changed for this computer (see `cmsy_system()`: the `windows()` and `antialias`
changes of the user guide for macOS and Linux, and removing RStudio, the archived snpar
package and the automatic package installation). The folders keep the original CMSY++ output
(`cmsy_output.csv`, the JPEG charts and the log), so each result can be checked.

Since FAO data have no abundance index, only the catch-only part of CMSY++ runs. Following FAO
(2026), whose global review uses CMSY++ among its Tier 3 (data-limited) methods, the status is
given in two classes only: "maximally sustainably fished" (B/Bmsy at least 0.8 in the last
year) or "overfished" (B/Bmsy below 0.8); catch-only results are not used to call a stock
underfished.

</details>

## 参考文献

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., et al. (2023). New developments in the analysis of catch
time series as the basis for fish stock assessments: the CMSY++ method. Acta Ichthyologica et
Piscatoria 53: 173-189. [doi:10.3897/aiep.53.105910](https://doi.org/10.3897/aiep.53.105910)

FAO (2026). The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2026. Rome, FAO. Section "The status
of fishery resources", Box 1.3 (assessment tiers and status classes).
<https://openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/09d03e2f-7097-4d59-bf94-db65e95f44fd/content/sofia-2026/the-status-fishery-resources.html>

## 示例

```r
cmsy_setup()                                       # once
FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central", plot = FALSE)
input <- cmsy_input(FAO34$area_data)

# Bigeye grunt, with the start year suggested by CMSY++ and a fixed seed
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "Brachydeuterus auritus", auto_start = TRUE, seed = 1)
result$summary[, c("Stock", "first_year", "B_Bmsy", "B_Bmsy_lcl", "B_Bmsy_ucl", "F_Fmsy", "status")]
head(result$series)                                # catch, B/k, biomass, B/Bmsy, F/Fmsy by year

# Every CMSY++ chart of the user guide, including the retrospective analysis
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE,
                   plots = c("analysis", "management", "kobe", "prior_posterior", "retrospective"))

# Changed CMSY++ settings (see cmsy_defaults()): longer chains and a larger catch error
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1,
                   settings = list(n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000, CV.C = 0.2))
result$settings[result$settings$changed, c("setting", "cmsy_default", "used")]

# The ten main stocks, four at a time, without progress bar or messages
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = input$stocks$Stock[1:10], parallel = 4, silent = TRUE)

# Settings that would be used on Windows, and charts in the system's own windows
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", os = "windows")
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", device = "screen")

# Versions and links of everything used, for the methods section of a report
result$sources
```
